description: Madagascar - Education Facilities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. Education facilities in Madagascar extracted from Open Street Map data. © OpenStreetMap contributors and Geofabrik GmbH. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy demand. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
